description.zh:
实例ID。

<props="china">您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。</props>

<props="china">
> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。</props>
description.en:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the **ID** of your current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID exists, you must specify it; otherwise, the invocation will fail.</props>

<props="china">
> If your public instance does not have an ID, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

description.zh:
设置项目协作状态。
- **0**（默认）： 关闭。
- **1**： 开通。
description.en:
The status of project collaboration.
- **0** (default): Shutdown.
- **1**: Enabled.

descriptions.zh:
## 限制说明
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Limits
Each Alibaba Assistant Cloud account can send a maximum of 5 queries per second (QPS) when invoking this API.  
> RAM users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
